cs.t: My first LCD monitor. A couple months later I was at the local surplus goods shop and they had gorgeous Sun 21" CRTs for $75 each.  I broke down and passed the virtually new $350 LCD to other family members. It ended up Capacitor Plaguing itself to death after like 3 years.  I tried replacing the bulgetacular caps, but no dice.
cs.th: Ask HN: What are your most regretted tech purchases?
